threats.title: #1 Spoofed AI agent presents stolen OBO token
threats.description: Spoofed AI agent presents stolen OBO token
threats.mitigation: Enforce short-lived OBO tokens with sender-constrained proof of possession.

threats.title: #2 RAG context or tool arguments tampered
threats.description: RAG context or tool arguments tampered
threats.mitigation: Sign and validate contextual embeddings and function call payloads.

threats.title: #3 Missing non-human identity audit trail
threats.mitigation: Correlate human user sessions with M2M agent service audit records.

threats.title: #4 Prompt injection discloses LLM API key
threats.description: Prompt injection discloses LLM API key
threats.mitigation: Isolate API keys in backend secret managers; never expose credentials to the context window.

threats.title: #5 Unbounded tool loops exhaust quotas
threats.mitigation: Enforce recursion depth limits, call timeouts, and tool invocation budgets.

threats.title: #6 Agent elevates to admin API scope
threats.description: Agent elevates to admin API scope
threats.mitigation: Implement fine-grained scoped tokens with least privilege principle.
